integrity: The residual-factor identity and repeated-shift ADI recurrence are independently instantiated for the displayed family. The exact solution, both ADI approximations, residual matrices, nilpotent Cayley factor, and one-dimensional boundary case are derived explicitly. The standalone exact-rational checker replays representative instances but does not replace the symbolic all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact-arithmetic construction for a two-dimensional highly nonnormal continuous-time Lyapunov equation, one right-hand-side column, zero initial approximation, and a repeated real ADI shift. It does not bound residual spikes under numerical-range, dissipativity, eigenvector-conditioning, or finite-precision restrictions.
title: A two-step exact Lyapunov ADI solve can have an arbitrarily large first residual spike
